newsitem.title: DUBAI: Omani stocks clock up strong gains in the week.
newsitem.headline: Omani stocks clock up strong gains in the week.

text.p: Oman's stock exchange clocked up strong gains in the week to Wednesday, with buying interest focused on banks and investment firms, a market report said.
The Muscat Securities Market said the index closed more than 3.5 percent, or 7.29 points, higher at 211.71 points as investors ploughed into stocks expected to announce better 1996 results.
Trade was active, with value dealt reaching 14.3 million rials ($37.5 million) and 7.2 million shares changing hands.
Of the 54 companies traded in the week, shares of 29 rose, nine fell and 16 were unchanged.
Oman International Bank was sharply higher, closing at 4.010 rials -- 0.510 rials above the previous week's finish.
National Bank of Oman added 0.330 rials to end at 3.940 rials. Al-Ahlia Portfolio Securities also firmed, ending at 3.900 rials from 3.560 rials.
The MSM said there was strong demand for the newly listed Oman Savings and Finance Bank, with 3.4 million shares dealt.
